description:
A simple, easy-to-use, and powerful file manager Buge Files is a modern, lightweight and privacy‑friendly file manager that helps you browse, organize and manage files stored on your device. Built with Material Design 3 Expressive, it offers a clean and intuitive interface for efficient file browsing and storage management. Features
  • Browse and manage files and folders with a modern card-style layout
  • Smart categories — automatically organize files by type (Images, Videos, Music, Documents, Archives, APK) for quick access
  • Storage overview with visual progress indicators
  • View file details including size and modification date
  • Switch between multiple languages and Light, Dark, or System theme
  • Toggle visibility of hidden files and folders
  • Modern, clean and minimal UI
  • No ads, no analytics, fully open source
Notes
  • Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher
  • ROOT is optional / available for rooted and authorized devices
  • Local-only file access, so your data stays on your device
Source code: https://github.com/BugeStudioTeam/Buge-Files
